assets.name: slums
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: landscape environment painting for a 2D pixel-art racing game, Edgerunner. Create a wide 1536x1024 pixel-art landscape with crisp visible pixel clusters and disciplined midnight-navy shadows. Raised rear chase camera facing forward down a four-lane drainage channel in a vast cyberpunk slum. The center lower third is a relatively plain dark road with four clear lanes, absolutely no players or UI. Patched corrugated shelters climb basin walls on both sides, amber windows, exposed copper pipes, rain puddles, laundry and overhead cables. A scaffold shortcut peels up to the left, while the wider channel continues ahead; both lead toward a distant lit security gate beneath white towers. Foreground rusty railings, midground dwellings, background elevated roads. Warm copper highlights, teal mist, strong readable silhouette layers. No text, no gadgets, no logos, no watermark. This is in-game environmental key art, with open central space for actual track objects to be drawn.

assets.name: downtown
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: landscape environment painting for Edgerunner, a 2D pixel-art cyberpunk race. Create a wide 1536x1024 pixel-art landscape, crisp visible pixel clusters, same disciplined dark navy outlines and amber accents as a cyberpunk slum game, but this district is bright white ceramic, brushed gold, pale cyan glass. Raised rear chase camera facing a four-lane futuristic boulevard. The center lower third is an uncluttered pale blue-gray road with four readable lanes; no players or UI. Tall glass towers, elevated train across far skyline, holographic gardens only on pavements, wealthy storefronts, polished transit plaza. A narrow glass service corridor branches to the left; a wide curved terrace promenade climbs to the right and reconnects in the distance. Black and gold spaceport access arch visible far ahead. Clear atmospheric perspective, strong foreground/midground/background separations. No text, gadgets, logos or watermark. Keep the traversable center readable for actual game obstacles.

assets.name: spaceport
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: wide orbital environment key art for Edgerunner pixel-art racing game. Create a wide 1536x1024 pixel-art illustration with crisp pixel clusters and readable large shapes, midnight navy, steel, amber, blue-white glow. View from just outside an industrial orbital launch hangar into open space. Hangar door frame and cargo gantries at far sides and bottom edges; red runway beacon lights fading below. The curved blue Earth occupies lower background, black stars above, sparse abandoned solar-panel arrays to far sides. Straight ahead at upper center, the Crystal Palace: faceted glass luxury space station with a broad unmistakable gold docking ring, luminous gardens and slender radial structures. Central flight corridor is broad open space, with room for four horizontal lanes and three altitudes to be drawn by the game, no painted lane rails through space. Camera slightly lower than raised ground chase view. No ships, people, UI, gadgets, text, watermark. Strong layered depth and a clear finish destination.

assets.name: racers
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent PNG sprite atlas for the Edgerunner 2D Canvas game. Exact 2-column by 2-row grid on fully transparent background, no text, no grid lines or labels. Equal cells with large transparent gutters, every subject entirely inside its cell. Top-left: cyan runner, graphite armored athletic suit with TWO parallel bright cyan stripes running down back, swept narrow full helmet, compact basic pistol in right hand pointed ahead. Top-right: magenta runner, dark plum armor with ONE diagonal bright magenta stripe across back, broad square full helmet, same compact basic pistol. Both are full-body mid-stride RUNNING AWAY from viewer, elevated rear chase camera, head at top, feet at bottom, same scale; no faces, no capes, no extra gear, no shield bubbles. Bottom-left: cyan shuttle, graphite compact wedge spaceship with twin cyan stripes, narrow forward nose at TOP, TWO visible cyan engine exhausts at BOTTOM, small simple fixed forward cannon pointing TOP parallel to hull. Bottom-right: magenta shuttle, broader plum wedge with diagonal magenta marking, nose at TOP, twin magenta thrusters at BOTTOM, same basic forward cannon. Spaceships seen from elevated REAR view, longitudinal axis exactly vertical in image, no side view. Pixel art with crisp blocks, limited highlights, dark navy outlines, readable silhouette at 64px tall. All four sprites share consistent illumination. Genuine transparency, no backdrop, no floor, no cast shadow, no text, no decorative objects.

assets.name: character-design
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: polished character and spacecraft design board for Edgerunner, wide landscape 1536x1024. Crisp pixel art with visible clusters, dark midnight navy artboard, subtle amber separators. Four equal vertical columns. Column 1 cyan runner: graphite slim armor, swept full helmet, TWO bright cyan parallel stripes; large full-body rear three-quarter view and small front and side thumbnails. Column 2 magenta runner: broad squared helmet, dark plum armor, ONE diagonal magenta stripe; large full-body rear three-quarter and small front/side thumbnails. Both use only one compact default pistol and a thin three-segment personal shield arc demonstrated beside them; no modules or gadgets. Column 3 cyan spaceship: compact slate wedge, twin cyan back stripes and twin cyan thrusters, nose visibly opposed to exhaust, small fixed forward cannon; large rear three-quarter view plus small top and side views. Column 4 magenta spaceship: broader plum wedge, diagonal magenta stripe, twin magenta engines, same simple fixed forward gun; large rear three-quarter plus small top/side views. Strict silhouette continuity from runner to their spacecraft. Header exact 'EDGERUNNER'. Column labels exact 'CYAN RUNNER', 'MAGENTA RUNNER', 'CYAN SHUTTLE', 'MAGENTA SHUTTLE'. No other text, no game UI, no watermark. Keep all drawings inside margins, equal prominence to both players.
